purpose: Bounded test of Triton TF32x3 for the flow head's DiT MLP and QKV/output linears. Earlier ordinary TF32 failed long-protein batching controls; this is a different, explicitly labeled arithmetic candidate.
selection: Longest existing tuning protein in each128/256/384/512 bucket, ID tie-break, without inspecting student outcomes. Original and balanced aligned500 weights; original CFG2 and balanced CFG1, Euler25,decoder3.
micro_controls: Float32 inputs and weights, ragged and aligned shapes, bias/no-bias. Compare ordinary TF32 and TF32x3 with torch FP32 against a float64 product rounded tofloat32. Require every TF32x3 relative-RMS error<=1e-5 and finite outputs before model tests. This is not a proof of IEEE equality.
model_controls: Exact-length single, padded single, padded batches8/32, identical target-indexed flow and decoder noise. FP32 and TF32x3 linears each require single-versus-batch CA-RMSD<=0.2A and pair CA-lDDT>=0.99. All matched FP32-versus-candidate samples require those same structural tolerances. Keep all control outcomes. Four selected proteins do not establish full-panel accuracy or distribution equivalence.
precision_scope: Only DiT MLP and attention QKV/output linear projections use TF32x3 tensor-core arithmetic. All tensors remain float32. Attention products, pair track, normalization/modulation, integration and ProteinAE decoding retain the original IEEE FP32 policy. No training or weight changes. Scoped module wrappers must restore original modules and state names after errors.
timing: One warmup per layout/precision followed by three timed flow-plus-decoder-and-transfer repeats. Compilation belongs to warmup and is reported separately. These cached-conditioner stage timings exclude ESMC and noise construction, so they are not sequence-to-structure speedups.
next: Only if every numerical/model control passes and measured model-stage speed improves, consider full64-family quality and48-family ensemble validation, then matched sequence-to-backbone timing. No quality threshold relaxation or automatic promotion.
resources: One RTX PRO6000 Blackwell,15-minute cap,840-second work cap,85% allocator ceiling. Use installed Triton/PyTorch only; project-owned compile cache, no package installation. Total project GPUs<=8.
